findings.description: Nonfinite density inputs return NaN before incrementing audit counters. Counters therefore omit these rejected attempts. This does not compromise numerical rejection or accepted-state domain checking and is not a blocker for this pilot; counters must not be described as an exhaustive record of invalid calls.

limitations: Approval covers only the five changed core API/selector files against baseline 26b7b72532b7586c0afe504daf67a831d764bf4d. CLI integration and diagnostics remain unreviewed.

Actual candidate source and every validated-source.json hash were checked. check-0.log is empty; check-1.log reports 144 passing checks; check-2.log records compilation and linking with warnings. No builds, tests or planetary solvers were executed during this review.

Strict checking defaults off. When enabled, bounds use the actual loaded axes, including legacy float conversions, with cgs-to-GPa conversion for density and GPa input for dTdP_S. Out-of-domain table queries are rejected before legacy clamping; tabletype2 gradients are explicitly rejected.

All 111 exported EOS pointers receive distinct symbol-based IDs. The new selector uniformly returns existing Gas_hhe, and settings validation requires external TP. Existing EOS mathematics and default selectors remain unchanged.
The water III fixture uses 0.3 GPa and 250 K; the correction changes the test only.
Bounds checking establishes numerical table-domain validity only. This approval does not certify empirical fits, phase thermodynamics, physical EOS validity or planetary results.
